data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 gross claims outstanding were GBP 476.835m. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded a gross release on prior years of GBP 48.607m (approximately 10.2% of opening gross claims), primarily reflecting favourable claims development and generally benign loss experience. Large loss events in 2022 such as Hurricane Ian and the Ukraine conflict were reported to be within planned assumptions and did not prevent the net prior-year release. No LOB-specific prior-year reserve movements were disclosed in the notes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development sourced from the 'Movement arising from prior years' row in the insurance liabilities reconciliation (note 12) which gives the gross amount (explicit). No gross claims development triangle or LOB-level prior-year movement breakdown was provided, so per-line movements are not available. Percentage computed from opening gross claims outstanding. Narrative sentence describing the release was taken from the Managing Agent's report. Confidence: gross figures explicit in notes.
